cd /d/PROJECT_INNOTECH/Inspector_vision/Inspector_bottles/.claude/worktrees/t55c-impl && cat > docs/reviews/2026-10-03_task-5.5c-developer.md <<'EOF'
# Task 5.5c part A — developer report (2026-10-03)

Branch `fix/t55c-gate-green`, from 171f60fcc. Worktree `.claude/worktrees/t55c-impl`.

## Acceptance (run from the worktree root, PYTHONPATH=root, PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8, QT_QPA_PLATFORM=offscreen)

| Command | Result |
|---|---|
| `ruff check .` | `All checks passed!` |
| `pyright multiprocess_framework multiprocess_prototype` | `0 errors, 321 warnings, 0 informations` |
| `bandit -r multiprocess_framework multiprocess_prototype Services -c pyproject.toml -q -ll` | exit 0 |
| `python -m pytest -q` (root, WITHOUT `--ignore=scripts/docs_verify`) | `10607 passed, 97 skipped, 1 xfailed, 2 xpassed, 199 warnings in 1245.10s` (0 failed, 0 errors) |
| `python scripts/run_framework_tests.py` | `10750 passed, 41 skipped, 1 xfailed, 78 warnings in 787.32s` |
| `git switch --detach HEAD && pytest scripts/validate_commit/tests -q` | `10 passed in 2.28s` |
| `pytest scripts/docs_verify/tests -q` | `36 passed` (was 29 failed) |

Note: the framework run started before the last two commits (both touch only test conftests in Services/Plugins).

## Per failure

| Failure | Diagnosis | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| validate_commit wrapped_why / wrapped_layer | folding lost in b1e03bafb | restored in `parse_message` (git-style: block starts with a trailer, other lines fold) |
| validate_commit tests depend on branch | `validate()` finds the plan by branch slug | autouse fixture patches `validate_commit.plan_for_branch -> None` in test_validate_commit.py; validator not loosened |
| ruff 7 | 5 F401 (autofix), 2 E501 | autofix; two comments shortened |
| pyright 1 | `hub_stats_channel._last_dropped` inferred `int | None` | `self._last_dropped: int = 0` |
| line_sim 2 (font_tool, 5_3b) | env: PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 makes the child write UTF-8, parent decodes cp1251 | `encoding="utf-8"` + `PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8` in `_run_tool` of both files; green with and without the env var |
| test_env_brand | `code_reader/sdk/loader.py:37` reads env by constant `ENV_VAR`; audit wants literals | read `"MVCR_SDK_DIR"` as literal (name now in two places, see open) |
| test_no_silent_swallows | 44 handlers in new plugins (sim/*, otel_export, strokes_to_points, camera_service) without `# no-health:`; camera_service tag stood ABOVE the `except` line | tag + reason on each `except` line, no behaviour change |
| camera_service stream bad url | `cv2.VideoCapture` on refused loopback port blocks 5.5 s on Windows (5.50 / 5.50 / 5.47 s, bare cv2); test join is 5 s. With `CAP_PROP_OPEN_TIMEOUT_MSEC` 1500 -> 1.61 s, 3000 -> 3.06 s | `xfail(win32, strict=True)`, OPEN_QUESTIONS entry; choosing the timeout number is the owner's call |
| backend_ctl probe profiles | test literal stale: `layers` process added in 0570070b2 | literal updated |
| observability test_empty_hint_and_lag 2 | tests written before Task 3.3; tap writes through async drain, panel read before the write; the `ProgrammingError` voice came from draining into a closed store | `tap.close()` before reading |
| docs_verify 29 | one real gap: `queue_capacity` missing in CONTROL_PANEL "История" table | row added (default 4096; cadence from builtin_commands.py:2412-2425) |
| examples/minimal_app test_ci_smoke teardown ERROR | session guard `framework_metric_catalogue_guard` saw 8 leaked declarations (`exported`, `export_failed`, `mapper_rejected`, `received`, `resource_evicted`, `skipped_numbers`, `attr_coerced`, `dropped_overflow`) from `OtelExportPlugin.configure -> ctx.declare_metric` | autouse `declarations_snapshot` in `Plugins/io/otel_export/tests/conftest.py` AND `Services/otel_export/tests/conftest.py` (task22 files leak too). Bisect: Services/otel_export + guard -> 1 error; after fix 251 passed |

## Bandit Medium (16 x B608, MEDIUM/LOW), all verdict "false positive by construction" except one hardening

| File | Lines | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| Services/auth/storage/audit_storage.py | 270 | `where_clause` from literal fragments, values bound. nosec |
| Services/sql/action_log/repository.py | 54, 64, 70, 82 | table = class constant, values bound. nosec |
| Services/sql/core/base_repository.py | 44, 55, 67, 76, 91, 108, 119 | table/columns from schema, values bound. nosec. Line 119 (`find_by`): kwargs keys were NOT validated -> real gap, fixed with identifier regex + test (test dies when the check is removed: 1 failed / 8 passed) |
| Services/sql/core/queryset.py | 236, 258, 266, 280 | columns through `_validate_column`, limit/offset `int()`, values bound. nosec |

Makefile `security` target now has `-ll`. `[tool.bandit]` in pyproject unchanged (not needed).

## xfail count

Before 3, after 4 (`git grep -n "xfail(" -- "*.py" | wc -l`), limit 5. New: camera_service stream bad url (win32, strict).

## Files touched

Makefile; scripts/validate_commit/validate_commit.py + tests/test_validate_commit.py; Services/{auth,sql}/ (nosec, find_by, test); 3 Plugins tests + simulator.py + webcam.py (ruff); hub_stats_channel.py; test_socket_channel.py; Services/line_sim/tests (2); Services/code_reader/sdk/loader.py; Plugins/{io/otel_export,processing/strokes_to_points,sim/*,sources/camera_service}/plugin.py (+geometry.py); backend_ctl test; observability tab test; camera_service stream test; both otel_export conftests; CONTROL_PANEL.md; OPEN_QUESTIONS.md.

## Commits (explicit paths, none pushed)

3cc980709 validate_commit; 6f6c2e809 bandit; 2a4860d94 lint; 88963989f docs; 671f66101 line_sim+env_brand; d20660cd6 probe+tab tests; 8ac5b57f1 no-health tags; 7f52d7f9b camera xfail; dabb6f856 and 3971dcc8f otel_export conftests.

## What I interpreted rather than followed

- The brief listed `Services/line_sim 2`; I read it as the two tests `test_font_tool_rejects_font_without_glyph` and `test_letter_catalog_tool_missing_letter`.
- Brief said xfail OR fix. For stream bad url I chose xfail over inventing an open-timeout number (product behaviour change).
- Lead's mid-task message extended scope with CONTROL_PANEL.md; done as a separate `docs(observability)` commit.
- `find_by` hardening is beyond "nosec"; DESIGN allowed "fix where the finding is real".
- Fixing the minimal_app ERROR took two commits: the first fix covered only half the leakers; a 20-minute full run proved it.

## What I left open / unreliable

- ruff-format (pre-commit, line-length 120) reformatted whole files I touched: validate_commit.py (89 lines), 3 Plugins tests (about 150 lines of pure formatting), queryset.py. Diff noise, no behaviour change. Review should read those with `-w`.
- 2 xpassed in the root run: not investigated (existing xfail decorators in Services/robot_comm and process_module tests, non-strict).
- Flake seen once, not reproducible: `Plugins/sim/pult_web/tests/test_acceptance_r5_page.py::test_a2_undo_highlights_restored_layer_not_the_foreign_one` failed in a 924-test Plugins/sim run, passed 2/2 alone and in both full root runs.
- The `# no-health:` reasons are my reading of each handler (one pass), not verified per site; the gate only checks the tag exists.
- `nosec` B608 reasons rely on schema/class-constant identifiers; nobody ran an injection test on the 15 non-`find_by` sites.
- Invalid `# noqa` directive warning in `Plugins/hub/device_hub/tests/test_reply_envelope_acceptance.py:72` (ruff prints it, not an error) left alone.
- `MVCR_SDK_DIR` now duplicated in loader.py (constant + literal). Teach the audit to resolve module constants or accept the duplicate: OPEN_QUESTIONS.
- I did not break-inject my own test changes except `find_by` (done) and `test_empty_hint_and_lag` (red before, green after). The lead's matrix covers the rest.
- STOP-RULE files: not touched, no diagnosis led there.
